positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full stack engineering, with an emphasis on service-oriented architectural design and development. Service pushmaster for the messaging team, which owns Yelp's "Request A Quote", "Message the Business",  and MultiBiz features. 
• Backend: Docker acceptance testing, Python unit tests, SQAlchemy batch job development for MySQL database queries, Swagger JSON endpoint development, AB testing configuration and experimentation. 
• Frontend: Cheetah template development for HTML and asset generation, CSS and limited Javascript and NodeJS development.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Responsible for design and development of a utility to detect and recommend missed punches and their respective times across all Amazon shipping centers.

• Backend development in Java with Spring MVC and Coral Service frameworks for in-house app for Fulfillment Center management, aggregating multiple data sources across various frameworks (Dynamo DB, in house/ third party sources, etc.).

• Front end development to display backend logic results using AngularJS, HTML/ Javascript/ CSS, Bootstrap, and various plugins.

positions.title: Data Analytics Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a unique heuristic algorithm for estimating the future growth and relevance of emerging Big Data companies 

• Designed and defined a taxonomical breakdown of the leading subsectors within the big data industry to categorize emerging players 

• Identified matches between companies potentially exiting or entering the Big Data landscape through extant product offerings

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
• Scoped out demand for client’s services by researching competitors and analyzing and projecting future market demand 

• Analyzed changes in demand and market data to predict future trends and market shifts  Critiqued client’s business model by comparing product to target audience demands and redirecting misallocated resources

• Formulated final recommendations and implementable solutions for client start-up through frequent interaction with client company

patents.title: Method for adaptive audio signal shaping for improved playback in a noisy environment
